# The arcade floor: a 10 x 9 m plane (world z -2.2..6.8) of carpet, zigzag bands and dark confetti
# painted in a palette-exact 40 x 36 texture. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
add mesh grid --name Floor --size 1 --x-subdivisions 5 --y-subdivisions 5 --location 0 -2.3 0
scale 10 9 1
apply --scale
material new Carpet --base-color 1 1 1
material assign Carpet
active Floor
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Carpet base-color textures/carpet.png
shade flat
export floor.glb
